note: By-eye verdicts on the pole review sheets (fetch/pole_review_sheets.py: NGII 2025 photo chips with metre ticks around each seed). In this photo a pole shows as a thin pale or dark pole image leaning away from the photo nadir (relief) plus a thin shadow running west; the base is where the two meet. verdict seed = the base is at the seed; root = base at offsetM [east, south] metres from the seed; head = floodlight head at headPx (sheet col, row), base found by removing the relief lean; reject = no pole there; site = base not resolvable but the photo shows the seed on a median or island (kept at the seed, exempt from the carriageway raster, which paints medians as asphalt). Seeds with no entry are unresolved: survey and data.go.kr poles stay at their seed (metre-level), rule seeds are dropped.
